events.title: Atlassian Jira 1.0 released
events.summary: Atlassian shipped [Jira] 1.0 in April 2002 — a bug tracker and project-management tool that became the default issue system for software teams worldwide.
events.about: [Jira]'s workflow engine, custom fields, and JQL query language turned ticket tracking into a platform — sprints, backlogs, and release trains for [agile] teams. It paired with Confluence wikis and [Bitbucket] repos to anchor Atlassian's dev-tool stack; millions of engineers still live in [Jira] filters and board columns daily.

narrative.whyChosen: [Jira] became the lingua franca of software issue tracking in enterprises.
narrative.whyImportant: It standardized [agile] boards, workflows, and audit trails across engineering orgs.
narrative.problemSolved: [Teams] outgrew email and spreadsheets for tracking bugs and feature work.
